blocks.text: SAN ANTONIO, Zambales — Marginal farmers in Central Luzon will soon have a place where they can learn how to turn the task of growing food into businesses, find markets for their products and gain access to facilities and financing. The Agribusiness Incubation (ABI) Center, which will rise at the DA-Research Outreach Station for Lahar-Laden Areas Development in Barangay Rabanes in nearby San Marcelino town, is expected to provide farmers with shared office and processing facilities, training, mentoring and links to potential buyers and funding sources.
